crossRefs.note: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz…

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
translations.bsb: Their father Ephraim mourned for many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translations.kjv: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
translations.asv: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
